reviews.text:
I can’t say enough wonderful things about Vetique! From the moment we walked in, the space felt warm, welcoming and thoughtfully designed — but what really stood out was the incredible customer service and care they showed Bob.

Bob is a former barn cat who recently traded country life for his new adventure as a Chicago city kitty, so new places and experiences can still be a little intimidating for him. The Vetique team immediately made us both feel comfortable. They were patient, gentle and attentive, and you could tell they genuinely cared about making sure Bob felt safe and at ease throughout his visit.

The entire experience felt elevated without losing the warmth and personal touch you want when someone is caring for your pet. I left feeling completely confident that Bob was in great hands — and, most importantly, he left a happy city kitty!

So grateful to have found Vetique and would absolutely recommend them to other Chicago pet parents.
Amazing place! Everyone was so kind and took wonderful care of Mae. Thank you all!

Finally exceptional veterinarians in the city. Took my dog Luna in for some routine vaccinations and the vet went out of her way to ask about other health problems (mainly skin / allergy related) and really provided great help! She gave new food recommendations and other simple things to do at home. Her skin is much better now and we are grateful to the team at Vetique!
Teddy loves coming to Vetique they make him feel so comfortable and as a new puppy mom they always answer all my millions of questions

Vetique Is not your ordinary veterinarian hospital it is an upscale new concept in animal care located in the Gold Coast. I have traveled over an hour to bring my 3,dogs to have Dr. Jennifer Remnes care for them. She is extraordinary when it comes to Treating her patience, not only does she use medical science based evidence, She is extremely intelligent, Compassionate, Loyal, helpful, and very kind. She will go out of her way to provide exception veterinarian care. I do not trust anyone else to care for my three dogs except for Dr. Jennifer Remnes.

We love Vetique. Our experience in this lovely and well appointed, high-end vetrinary clinic was nothing short of incredible. The staff is kind and skilled and Dr.Remnes is exceptional. Thank you all so much!

I just brought Rocky to VET/IQUE for the first time and it was great - not only for him but also for me and my husband. The doctors are attentive, personable, and shared great recommendations with us. We will definitely be coming back for the experience (and also the Aperol Spritz)!

Vetique is a true utopia !!!!! Dr. Jessica Trice & Dr. Jennifer Remnes are amazing in their benevolent care !!!!!!!!!! I love their practice, they're amazing !!! I recommend this Illustrious establishment for all .💫💫💫💫 …

I took my 13-year-old dog Toby to see Dr. Trice at Vetique and couldn't be happier. Dr. Trice was wonderful with him — patient, gentle, and took the time to explain everything so I never felt rushed or confused. The tech who worked with us was just as great, and the whole place is beautiful, clean, and calm, which made a huge difference for an older dog who gets anxious at the vet. What really stood out was the follow-up afterward; they actually checked in to see how Toby was doing, which you don't get everywhere. Senior dogs need a team that really cares, and I've found mine. Highly recommend Dr. Trice and everyone at Vetique

Loretta has been coming here for about 9 months. We often get in same day and it is a nice change from other vet offices with the luxury aesthetic they have! I have compared prices to other local vets and everyone was about the same, making this an easy choice. One of the best physical exams that this feisty girl has had… ever. Usually gets cut short other places when she refuses to comply. They were patient and worked with her !
Brought my dog Bruiser in for an integrative consult and was treated so well. Bruiser had a great time and the staff is so welcoming. Looking forward to returning. Your pet is in good hands here

I almost don't want to write a review because I don't want everyone to know my secret vet! :) Vetique is simply incredible. The whole experience for both humans and pets is like none I've ever experienced. The staff and the vets are all genuinely kind, helpful, and so knowledgeable.
My italian greyhound Sienna looks forward to every appt here and all the workers are the nicest!
Absolutely love Vetique!! The doctors and vet techs are incredible and provide such loving and exceptional care for our cat Mahogany

I come here with my cat Monty and it’s great. The staff is super sweet and friendly and you can tell they are true animal people! The location is great and it’s super easy to set up appointments. I’ve never had any issues the several times I’ve gone and will continue going to them for any pet needs!
The only vet we go to for our baby
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Louay. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

Vetique is amazing! I just brought my cats, Finn & Bear, and we all had a great experience. The front desk staff is super welcoming and the office is clean and professional. The tech, Andy, was very friendly and helpful. And Dr Trice is lovely, she was so attentive and caring and really took the time to get to know us. I feel very lucky to have such a supportive vet office close by.
Thank you so much for the 5-star review, Daniel. We're glad you had a great experience with us!

After walking past this office several times, I decided to take Bardot in and establish her as a new patient. That was hands down the best thing Bardot and I have done when it comes to finding her a kind, caring and loving vet, in downtown Chicago. We have lived here 12 years and as soon as I walked in, the staff greeted us, offered us refreshments and checked us in. The room was so clean and thoughtful. There was even a Mau kitty condo in our room placed next to a window for Bardot to enjoy.

After meeting with the vet tech and then Dr. Trice, I was sold. She loves cats and has several of her own. Most vets downtown are dog focused and I’ve struggled to find a vet that loves Bardot as much as I do.

As we left, they gave us a gift bag. Bardot loved the treat so much, I called to ask where they got them. Then we got a special surprise!!! Bardot was over the moon. This will be our new downtown Chicago vet clinic, hands down. And speaking of hands, even the soap and lotion in the bathroom was thoughtful and luxurious. We loved our visit and are looking forward to seeing everyone again!

I cannot recommend Vetique enough! I have 2 kitties that I have been bringing here and every time my cats and me feel extremely comfortable and taken care of. They’re very accommodating and always willing to make things work for my schedule!

My little Shihpoo buddy and I absolutely love the atmosphere and service at this clinic. The veterinarians and staff are genuinely caring and thoughtful. She used to panic during medical visits, but not here. This team puts both of us at ease. I can relax, and my little buddy does too.
Everyone was very friendly and professional. They took great with Moose, who usually gets anxious at the vet. Highly recommend.
What a beautiful experience! Brought my new baby Pumpkin for a check-up and have never been to such a lovely vet. Thorough, kind, welcoming, and thoughtful. We will be back!

Recently moved to Chicago and took my dog there to establish care and get her latest vaccination. The Vetique team was professional, attentive, and even threw in a few complimentary services (ex. nail trimming) for our first visit. Would highly recommend!

I just started coming to Vetique for my new kitty Saoirse.  I am so happy I chose Vetique.  The office is welcoming as is the staff. Dr. Trice is so friendly, professional and answered all my questions.  Saoirse loved the examining room with the kitty tree and toys. Overall 2 thumbs way up!
Fantastic experience as a first time visitor. Extremely attentive and friendly people who love your animal just as much as you! Even got a ball to go home with and he is obsessed. Thank you Vetique!
Best Vet EVER!!! Dr’s are incredible and whole team is caring, experienced, and so thorough. Banks and (angel) Lola consider this home away from home. Such an incredible place!!!

Vetique is the ABSOLUTE BEST VETERINARY in all Chicago!!! They truly care about the fur babies, and I should know since I have 6 lol, one being a Cane Corso...They do follow up calls the next day, provide options and are very thorough with explaining procedures. They're patient, accommodating, friendly and extremely knowledgeable. You're in great hands here. Thank you to the entire team! You're the Best!

Very much love Vetique. Such a cool office space, reasonable prices, and most importantly — warm and thorough care. You can tell this team cares deeply about animals from the resources you receive as a new patient, to the long conversations during your appointments. I’m very glad we found them. We’ve seen both doctors and they’re truly special.

Perfect experience! For humans and the pups! My 5 month old Dobie was so relaxed! They offer complimentary drinks. Feeling like flying 1st class. The vets are incredible they take so much time and treat them like royalty. Never been to such an amazing clinic.

They are so great here! Both doctors are incredibly sweet, helpful, and attentive, and the office is always super clean, welcoming, and pretty. They were even able to squeeze in my cat, Miranda, for a last-minute same-day appointment when she unexpectedly developed an eye infection.

The reception team, vet techs, and vets all have such good energy, and Miranda honestly doesn’t even seem that stressed when she’s there. I’m so grateful for the care they’ve given her and would highly recommend them to anyone in the River North or Gold Coast area!
Great people. Professional and friendly. Dog loves them.
Absolutely love vetique, they're kind, knowledgable, and make sure my dog is very comfortable.
Vetique is the best!  Doctors, techs and support staff are all the most caring people ... and they take wonderful care of their patients in a very comfortable and inviting environment.
Proud to have found this vet after such a bad experience with another. Fans for life!

My two dogs Koda and Marvel get the best care of Vetique! The team there cares so much about them, is very transparent with pricing and different options, and is always helpful with any questions I may have. I would recommend Vetique to any of my friends or family!
You can tell Vetique really cares about their patients (and their paw-rents)! Couldn’t imagine taking my babies anywhere else

We just had our first appointment at Vetique and it was wonderful. We had a difficult time getting there due to the weather so were both flustered but as soon as we arrived everyone was extremely welcoming and helpful. They offered water and bone broth which immediately won my dog over. I can tell they truly care as they were very thorough when giving details, provided recommendations and transparent pricing, they were not pushy or rushed. They made us feel at home and trusting of their care. We are so happy we discovered Vetique and Cooper was one happy pug!

If you’re looking for the smartest, most well-equipped, friendly, and genuinely caring veterinary team, you’ve found the right place with Vetique. From the moment we started coming here, they have helped us thoughtfully navigate our pet’s health concerns with such professionalism and compassion. The doctors are incredibly knowledgeable and truly evidence-based in their approach, and the entire staff is just as wonderful.

What stands out most is how they treat your pets like family and focus on the bigger picture rather than just addressing symptoms. They take time to explain things, create thoughtful plans, and make you feel confident in every decision. Somehow, it’s actually become our dog’s favorite place to visit, which says everything. We are forever grateful that we chose this practice and couldn’t recommend Vetique more highly.

Update 2026: If you need an amazing vet, Vetique is the best! We recently had to say goodbye to our dog and the compassion shown by the ENTIRE Vetique team meant everything to us. They were patient, kind, and incredibly understanding during such a heartbreaking time. We are eternally grateful for the incredible care he received over the last year and that he was surrounded by such gentle, loving professionals in his final moments. Vetique should be your first call when you need outstanding veterinary care!

2025: We just moved to the area with a nervous and reactive dog. The staff (front office and vet tech) along with Dr Trice could not have been more welcoming and accommodating to make sure we all felt comfortable. Our dog did great during the exam and I felt the pricing was appropriate and fair.  We could not be happier after our first visit!

I cannot recommend Dr. Trice and the entire team at Vetique enough! Finding a vet you can truly trust is so important, and they exceed every expectation.
What sets them apart is the personalized attention; they truly get to know your pet and never make you feel like just another appointment. They are incredibly reliable and always accommodating, even when things get busy. It is so clear that the staff genuinely loves their patients—you can feel the care and compassion the second you walk through the door.
If you’re looking for a team that treats your pet like family, this is the place to go. Thank you, Dr. Trice and Vetique!" Love (Your favorite Italian Greyhounds, Roo + Willow, and their parents), Marie + Mark

We took our puppy into Vetique for the first time and we had an amazing experience! Dr. Jennifer and her team took their time answering all our questions, explaining the steps to check our puppy for an eye infection, and how to give her the medicine she needs. We felt very comfortable and taken care of and felt our puppy was in the best hands! Not to mention the facility is very chic and well maintained! We have definitely found our local vet!

I’ve been brining my cavapoo Elsie to Vetique since I’ve gotten her and it’s always been a great experience! Beth and Iliana at the front desk are very friendly and Drs. Remnes and Trice have always answered all my questions without rushing appointments which I appreciate!

This is the best vet that we have ever been to- and we have been to many vets.

Dr. Remnes is the sweetest, most down to earth person, and is so kind with all three of our kitties!

Illiana is an amazing person who is so supportive and quick to answer questions via email and phone!

Vetique has been so accommodating, understanding, and patient with my many questions and provides wonderful detailed reports, instructions, and assistance to ensure our babies are taken care of. They are quick to prioritize urgent needs and everyone provides an immense amount of empathy to not only the animals, but their owners.

I will continue to go here as long as I live in Chicago!
I love Dr Remnes and her team! Bailey is always treated like a princess!

If you are looking for devoted vets that will love your pet almost as much as you do... look no further! My cat, Andi, and I had the best experience at Vetique from the moment we walked in the door. The staff was incredibly friendly, and Dr. Trice took the time to listen to my concerns and make sure Andi felt loved. Thank you all for the wonderful experience and for taking such good care of my baby!

Took my dog, Ellie, here for the first time today to get her established at a new vet and get some vaccines that she was due for. I can’t believe I didn’t come here sooner! The staff couldn’t be more accommodating and sweet, and it was so clear that they care about all of the animals that come in. Ellie has previously had some bad reactions to routine vaccines, and the vets and techs were awesome with her and made sure to take every measure to avoid an allergic reaction. I really appreciate the staff listening so intently and making me and Ellie feel cared for and welcome. Could not recommend Vetique more!

We had a great visit with Dr. Trice! She was really great with our cat Gummy Bear. I had never seen her sit in a vet's lap before. This vet's level of attention to care for pets is unlike I have experienced before.

Vetique is the best vet in the city. Albert has been coming here for a few years and day or night, they’re always willing to assist and answer any questions we have when our pup gets into stuff he shouldn’t. Highly recommend coming to Vetique for all your pet needs.
Fantastic service and quick appt. for a new patient!

I brought my cat to Vetique to have a mass removed from his head, and I couldn’t have had a better experience. Everyone there is so kind, and Dr. Trice did an incredible job. She called me before, during, and after the surgery with updates, and the level of care and communication was truly top-tier. I’d recommend Vetique to any friend or family member.

I found Vetique when I moved to Chicago last year and you can’t find a better vet in the city! Everyone at the office is so kind and caring and I love how much they truly listen to your concerns. My dogs are always in great hands here !

If you're looking for vets that care, this is where you need to be. My Boxer was diagnosed with Cushing's disease. The vets and Vetique catered to him and showed him so much love until his final days. I'm so grateful for the care they gave Logan his skin and breathing improved tremendously during his treatment. I truly believe that because of Vetique Logan was able to give us one more year of smiles!

I took my puppy to Dr. Trice for her puppy vaccines and had an amazing experience. Being a first time puppy parent, there are many things you don't know and it can be overwhelming. Dr. Trice took the time to answer all of the questions I had as well as walk through the things that happen within the first year and what to expect. The time and care given by all staff has been beyond my expectations. Bonus points for the beautiful office space :)

Both my senior dogs go to Vetique.  They are the best Vet's in Chicago. They are extremely caring and have excellent diagnostic skills and provide in depth treatment plans.  Best of all my dogs are not afraid to go to vet and march in tails wagging.

My cat, Grady, was delighted with the care he received at Vetique after being traumatized at an adoption center. The doctor and med tech were so smart about how to keep him calm and happy. Grady even gave them head butts and kisses!  I was impressed with the considerate advice about caring for Grady’s FIV+ status and did not feel I was being “upsold” like I have at corporate owned vet clinics.  I’m also happy to support a local woman owned business.

Great first experience bringing my puppy, Dottie, in to see Dr. Trice for puppy vaccines. The location is chic, luxurious-feeling, and clean, and every staff member we interacted with was wonderful. Loved the added perks like complementary wine/water, pet snacks, and the goodie bag we received! I'll be transitioning our other pup over to start getting care at Vetique as well.

I cannot thank Vetique and Dr. Remnes enough for the support and care they have given my dog Sophie. From day one, Dr. Remnes has been absolutely wonderful, compassionate, attentive, and incredibly thorough in guiding us through. She has taken the time to review records, explain everything clearly, and reassure me when I needed it most.

It is such a comfort knowing we have a vet who truly cares and goes above and beyond for both pets and family. I feel very lucky to be part of the Vetique family and highly recommend them to anyone looking for outstanding veterinary care.
Everyone at Vetique is so kind and knowledgeable. I know my babies are in the best care! Sending love from Teddy and Butters!

My cat, Soda and I had the best time at Vetique! Dr. Remnes explained everything to clearly and I’ve never seen Soda more content at the vet. As a first time pet mom, I’m so glad I chose Vetique!! Soda and I can’t wait to go back!!

Friendly, informative, transparent staff. They took care of Levi well and even made us all feel welcomed. Their cat room was well designed and had treats. They let us know how much their services costs before and after the procedures. We will definitely keep going back!
Easily the best & least stressful vet visit I have ever experienced. Everyone in the office was so friendly, helpful & patient and I'm so glad I found a place I can trust! Would recommend to anyone!!
Thanks so much for the review!

Our first visit with our new dog - a two-year old Lab. The Vetique team was thorough, so kind and patient with our dog (and us!) and helped us feel that our dog was in the best possible care. Glad we chose this group.
Milo loved his first visit at vetique! All staff were very kind and loving towards him. They also gave me great information and tips as a first time pet owner. I would definitely recommend this vet!

I just moved to the area and decided to try this clinic because it’s close and convenient. I called in advance to confirm they could take a new client and told them my dog was having explosive diarrhea.

When we arrived, knowing my dog was sick, they gave him a full cup of peanut butter and a cup of frozen beef — which he’s sensitive to even when healthy. An assistant spent about 30 minutes going over notes before the vet came in, and then the vet asked me all the same questions again.

For our first visit, I was charged over $300 for just a stool exam. They didn’t even check my dog’s temperature or weight. The stool test came back negative, but they never reached out with any additional steps or solutions to help my dog.

When I called to follow up, they told me it would be another $150+ just to bring him back in.

Overall, I left feeling like they were more focused on charging for visits than actually helping my dog feel better.

I’m honestly mad at myself for not finding this place sooner. My old vet always made me feel rushed and dismissed. My cat, Soot, was so scared she wouldn’t even come out of her carrier. This experience was the complete opposite.

Everyone here was incredibly kind, patient, and open to questions. Dr. Jessica Trice took her time with us. She didn’t rush the appointment or pressure Soot into anything. Soot actually felt comfortable enough to come out and explore the room, even climbing into the exam room cat tree like she owned the place.

They had plenty of treats (Soot helped herself to a Churu), complimentary drinks for pet owners, and even an option for an online pharmacy. On top of all that, it was cheaper than my old vet.

I left feeling not just that Soot was well cared for but that I could trust this team completely. I’m already excited to bring the new kitten I’m getting in August! Thank you guys so much for showing us that going to the vet can be enjoyable for owners and pets!
The staff is so friendly and knowledgeable! Teddy loves coming here

Dr. Trice and Dr. Remnes are the best veterinarians Oliver and I have ever worked with!! The entire team is welcoming and kind, always offering a beverage and checking in on us before our appointment.
Oliver has skin allergies and sensitivities, but both Dr. Trice and Dr. Remnes take time with me to explain the treatment plan, the process of the appointment and any costs.
We have been to other vets in the area without as much care or attention. While it was “fine,” Vetique goes above and beyond and makes us feel at ease (to the point where Oliver enjoys going).
I would not consider taking my baby boy anywhere else!!

Wonderful clinic - has helped me through the highs and the lows of pet ownership. The employees are very responsive and friendly and always willing to answer my questions. I have grown to depend on their expertise. The location is also very convenient.

Dream's (minature schnauzer) experience was amazing! They did a great job in making sure she was comfortable, her tail wagged at the end of her visit! (which is HUGE) Not to mention, my experience was amazing as well.  The nurse and the doctor was very thorough, giving me options, and ensuring what ever I chose, they would accommodate us. This is our new vet home! And my coffee was perfect!! Thank you to everyone and Dream's friend that referred us! (Milo)

Our dachshund Vienna LOVES Vetique!!! We’ve tried a few vets in Chicago and this by far has been the best experience. They treat her like one of their own and she gets so excited when she sees them, especially Aly! We’re so grateful to have found a place that’s so caring and there for any questions or concerns we have. 1000/10 recommend!

Called in early afternoon with my cat experiencing a possible UTI, and they got me in at 4:00. The whole staff was attentive and caring to me and my cat. The calmest my cat has ever been in a vet's office ❤️. Thank you!

Our cat Millie is not typically a fan of the vet's office, but she loves Vetique. While she shows her big personality, the staff remains cool, calm, and collected. They're comforting to Millie's dads, too. We appreciate the genuine concern for her wellbeing and how that manifests in her care - and the cost is reasonable. Highly recommend!

We love Vetique! Everyone is so kind and friendly to both us and our pups. They know our dogs are our children and pamper them to the extreme to make going to the vet a fun experience. We are so thankful for all they do for our pups 🐾 …

The absolute kindness staff and best service. Very reasonably priced. I tool my two cats Shark and Bruce nutter for a wellness exam and I did not feel like I was being upsold or anything. They took their time and did not rush any part of the process. They took such great care of me and my boys! 100% would recommend.

6 stars my god - I just adopted my doberman floof and she is VERY anxious right now. Foster family told me she was horrible at the vet, so terrified and had to be muzzled etc. NOT the case here! They were SO kind, they let us stop by the day before our first appt and gave her lots of treats and let her sniff around. Today was our appt and they had so many treats and toys for her and I don't think she even knew she was at the vet honestly.
Best vet ever. Ellie is so well loved and cared for

Vetique staff are so kind and compassionate with both me and my pup! Dr. Remnes & Dr. Trice are so friendly and really make us feel welcome! They treat her so gently and give her great care. My first visit was a bit of a shock due to the cost compared to my last vet, but Dr. Remnes was so kind with explaining it all...and I learned that I could choose what we do now vs. what can wait, and I always take the most conservative approach. They're now very upfront with costs BEFORE anything is done and I now know I don't have to just blindly say yes to everything. They're very thorough and so loving with my pup, I know she's getting the greatest care!! I highly recommend them, it's a wonderful place...your babies will be in good hands!
Everything I expected and more. I read every single review on 3 or 4 vet clinics and then decided to try this place. Both Gaylord (my cat) and I are very happy!!!!

★★★★★ The vet care equivalent of a standing ovation

It’s hard to explain how rare it is to find a place like Vetique, and even harder to explain how rare it is to find a vet like Dr. Jessica Trice. If the standard of care in most clinics is “kind and competent,” then Dr. Trice is playing in an entirely different league—one where clinical excellence, human warmth, and deep attention to both pet and person converge in a way that feels… honestly, a little magical.

From the moment we walked into Vetique, it felt less like a vet visit and more like being welcomed into a wellness retreat for your animal (and your nerves). But aesthetics aside, what truly sets this place apart is how much time Dr. Trice takes. Time to observe, to explain, to listen—not just to the symptoms, but to our whole story. She treats you like a partner in your pet’s care, not a passenger.

If you're looking for a vet who combines clinical skill with true empathy—and a clinic that treats your pet like the singular creature they are—Vetique and Dr. Trice are worth every penny. They’ve got our loyalty for life.

Vetique took amazing care of my Pomeranian during her surgery. The staff were the sweetest people—so kind, professional, and genuinely caring. They even sent me regular update emails, which gave me so much peace of mind. My pup came home happy and healing beautifully. Truly champagne-level service for your furry family member. Highly recommend!

We had a great experience in this clinic , nice people’s explained everything and price was reasonable and same in comparison to clinics somewhere far from downtown .
Also liked attention to details like this small emails, made our experience even more positive and less stressful.

I have been taking my cat Theodore to Vetique since I moved to Chicago last year. Hands down, this is the best vet I have ever been to! Everyone there is so kind, encouraging, and helpful. They never fail to put my worries at ease. Theodore love it too, as soon as we get back in a room I can tell he recognizes where we are. He chills out and hops on the cat tree and is right at home.  Anyone who is looking for a vet, come here!! You won’t regret it.

Update: I returned to Vetique with my other cat Thackeray and met Dr Remnes. She was extremely thorough, thoughtful, and took the time to calculate the caloric intake for my cat Thackeray so that he would be able to eat a calming diet and not gain weight. She also was kind enough to give me the name if an animal behavioralist if I needed one to curb some of Thackeray’s biting tendencies. I was highly impressed with the practice, from Illiana at the front desk to Martha and Ollie the vet techs, and of course both vets! They are compassionate and are very professional and kind to the owners too! Next week I bring in Hecate to get her missing microchip replaced. I can’t say enough good things about these vets!

I took my cat Emily with a staph infection to see Dr Trice yesterday and had a great experience! The vet, Dr Trice, was very thorough, knowledgeable, and gave me a regimen of medications for my cat Emily that is sure to cure her very stubborn infection that her previous vet failed to do over five months! The tech Martha was very helpful and patient, and the rest of the staff were very friendly. The office overall gave me a sense of calmness and confidence and helpfulness, a big change from my previous vet experiences! A big thanks for taking on this stubborn infection on a same-day basis as a new patient! Emily and I are very happy. We even got a follow-up phone call to see how she is doing! Very grateful.

Just had our first vet appointment here for our two 9 week old kittens, Merry and Pippin. The team at Vetique, specifically Dr. Remnes, Illiana, and Martha were all so amazing and treated our babies with so much care and compassion. They treated my fiance and I with a high level of kindness and professionalism as well, and answered all of our questions thoughtfully! I didn’t know a trip to the vet could be so stress-free for both us and our pets. Also the inside of the office blew us away. Very classy and cute. And the exam room had a fluffy cat tree that our fur babies immediately loved. 20/10 experience, cannot recommend them enough!

I cannot say enough wonderful things about Vetique. From the moment you walk in, you’re met with such warmth and professionalism. Truly it feels more like stepping into a spa. The entire team goes above and beyond to make both you and your pet feel cared for, heard, and at ease.

One of the standout perks? They offer wine and mimosas to help pet owners relax during appointments. It is such a thoughtful and unexpected touch that speaks volumes about their commitment to creating a calm, welcoming environment that I have yet to experience anywhere else.

My dog has IVDD, and we’ve been to more vets than I can count over the years. Vetique is the first place where I truly felt like the staff took the time to listen, not just to my concerns, but to what has actually worked for my dog in the past. He’s currently receiving acupuncture and laser therapy here, and I’ve been so impressed with how gently and attentively the treatments are administered.

Vetique is truly something special. Their blend of compassion, expertise, and customer service is unmatched, and I’m beyond grateful to have found them. Highly, highly recommend.
Great

My dog and I just moved to Chicago and were looking to get established with a primary vet. My dog is almost 7 years old and has severe anxiety issues. The Vetique veterinarians, vet techs, and staff were warm and welcoming, knowledgeable and took the time to really listen to my concerns and quickly came up with a plan to help my dog with his transition to a new city. I never felt rushed and they took my concerns seriously which meant so much me. I am so appreciative for their help and we look forward to working with them again!

I'd give this place 100 stars if I could! The staff and Dr. Trice are so amazing! They all go above and beyond for your fur babies. I went in for my cats annual check-up and turns out he had to have his teeth cleaned (so good thing we brought him in!) so we scheduled asap and brought him back within the next week. I was SO nervous. He has a lifelong urinary problem so I asked if they could get him in first, seeing as if he gets too stressed, it can possibly create crystals in his bladder and I didn't want to risk anything! bc it was his first time for a dental cleaning. They literally took him in first, got to work right away and literally within 20 minutes, he was all done! No major teeth issues; a clean bill of health! They take care of your fur babies like they are their own. This will be my primary veterinary clinic.

I'm currently pursuing my veterinarian degree and honestly, I was so doubtful but Dr. Trice has given me the boost to keep going. Thank you to the staff and for all that you guys do! He was relaxed a the entire time, and smiled all the way home. Dog Mom also appreciated the goodie bag we left with and the one - okay, two - mimosas! If you're relaxed, your pet will be relaxed and Vetique has it figured out!

All that said, the staff was next level. Dr. Trice was like a ray of sunshine and immediately started soothing Heater. If you’re considering taking your pet to a new vet in Chicago, Vetique is absolutely where you should go. I can’t speak to the experience dog owners will have, but if it’s anything like mine, your pup will come out healthier and happier with a fantastic new doctor!
